review.title: Apportionment of Representatives
review.plain: Representatives are apportioned among the States by counting the whole number of persons in each State, excluding Indians not taxed. If a State denies or abridges the right to vote of male citizens twenty-one years of age, its basis of representation shall be reduced in proportion.

provisions.what: Representatives shall be apportioned among the several States according to their respective numbers, counting the whole number of persons in each State, excluding Indians not taxed
requires: counting the whole number of persons in each State, excluding Indians not taxed

provisions.what: when the right to vote at any election for the choice of electors for President and Vice President of the United States, Representatives in Congress, the Executive and Judicial officers of a State, or the members of the Legislature thereof, is denied to any of the male inhabitants of such State, being twenty-one years of age, and citizens of the United States, or in any way abridged, the basis of representation therein shall be reduced in the proportion which the number of such male citizens shall bear to the whole number of male citizens twenty-one years of age in such State
requires: the basis of representation therein shall be reduced in the proportion which the number of such male citizens shall bear to the whole number of male citizens twenty-one years of age in such State
conditions: when the right to vote at any election for the choice of electors for President and Vice President of the United States, Representatives in Congress, the Executive and Judicial officers of a State, or the members of the Legislature thereof, is denied to any of the male inhabitants of such State, being twenty-one years of age, and citizens of the United States, or in any way abridged
exceptions: except for participation in rebellion, or other crime

review.title: Disqualification for insurrection or rebellion
review.plain: No person who, having taken an oath as a member of Congress or a State legislature, or as a federal or State officer, to support the Constitution, engaged in insurrection or rebellion against it or gave aid or comfort to its enemies may hold office; Congress may remove this disability by a two-thirds vote of each House.
powers: Congress may by a vote of two-thirds of each House, remove such disability
limits: No person shall be a Senator or Representative in Congress, or elector of President and Vice President, or hold any office, civil or military, under the United States, or under any State

provisions.what: No person shall be a Senator or Representative in Congress, or elector of President and Vice President, or hold any office, civil or military, under the United States, or under any State, who, having previously taken an oath to support the Constitution of the United States, shall have engaged in insurrection or rebellion against the same, or given aid or comfort to the enemies thereof
provisions.binds: Any person who, having previously taken such an oath, engaged in insurrection or rebellion or gave aid or comfort to the enemies thereof
forbids: being a Senator or Representative in Congress, or elector of President and Vice President
holding any office, civil or military, under the United States, or under any State
conditions: having previously taken an oath, as a member of Congress, or as an officer of the United States, or as a member of any State legislature, or as an executive or judicial officer of any State, to support the Constitution of the United States
shall have engaged in insurrection or rebellion against the same, or given aid or comfort to the enemies thereof

provisions.what: Congress may by a vote of two-thirds of each House, remove such disability
conditions: by a vote of two-thirds of each House

review.title: Public debt; Confederate debts void
review.plain: The validity of the public debt of the United States, authorized by law, shall not be questioned. Neither the United States nor any State shall assume or pay any debt incurred in aid of insurrection or rebellion, or any claim for the loss or emancipation of any slave; all such are illegal and void.
limits: neither the United States nor any State shall assume or pay any debt or obligation incurred in aid of insurrection or rebellion against the United States

provisions.what: The validity of the public debt of the United States, authorized by law, including debts incurred for payment of pensions and bounties for services in suppressing insurrection or rebellion, shall not be questioned
forbids: questioning the validity of the public debt of the United States, authorized by law

provisions.what: neither the United States nor any State shall assume or pay any debt or obligation incurred in aid of insurrection or rebellion against the United States, or any claim for the loss or emancipation of any slave; but all such debts, obligations and claims shall be held illegal and void
provisions.binds: The United States and any State
requires: all such debts, obligations and claims shall be held illegal and void
forbids: assuming or paying any debt or obligation incurred in aid of insurrection or rebellion against the United States
assuming or paying any claim for the loss or emancipation of any slave

review.title: Power to enforce the Fourteenth Amendment
review.plain: Congress has power to enforce the provisions of this article by appropriate legislation.
powers: The Congress shall have power to enforce, by appropriate legislation, the provisions of this article

provisions.what: The Congress shall have power to enforce, by appropriate legislation, the provisions of this article

review.title: Right to vote regardless of race
review.plain: The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude.
rights: The right of citizens of the United States to vote
limits: shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude

provisions.what: The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude
provisions.binds: The United States or any State
forbids: denying or abridging the right to vote on account of race, color, or previous condition of servitude

powers: The Congress shall have power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation

review.title: Income tax
review.plain: Congress has power to lay and collect taxes on incomes, from whatever source derived, without apportionment among the States and without regard to any census or enumeration.
powers: The Congress shall have power to lay and collect taxes on incomes

provisions.what: The Congress shall have power to lay and collect taxes on incomes, from whatever source derived, without apportionment among the several States, and without regard to any census or enumeration

review.title: Direct election of Senators
review.plain: The Senate is composed of two Senators from each State, elected by the people for six years, each with one vote. The State executive issues writs of election to fill vacancies, and the legislature may empower the executive to make temporary appointments.
powers: the legislature of any State may empower the executive thereof to make temporary appointments

provisions.what: The Senate of the United States shall be composed of two Senators from each State, elected by the people thereof, for six years; and each Senator shall have one vote
The electors in each State shall have the qualifications requisite for electors of the most numerous branch of the State legislatures
requires: the qualifications requisite for electors of the most numerous branch of the State legislatures

provisions.what: When vacancies happen in the representation of any State in the Senate, the executive authority of such State shall issue writs of election to fill such vacancies
provisions.binds: The executive authority of such State
conditions: When vacancies happen in the representation of any State in the Senate

provisions.what: the legislature of any State may empower the executive thereof to make temporary appointments until the people fill the vacancies by election as the legislature may direct
This amendment shall not be so construed as to affect the election or term of any Senator chosen before it becomes valid as part of the Constitution
forbids: construing this amendment so as to affect the election or term of any Senator chosen before it becomes valid as part of the Constitution

review.title: Prohibition of intoxicating liquors
review.plain: One year after ratification, the manufacture, sale, or transportation of intoxicating liquors within, and their importation into or exportation from, the United States and its territory for beverage purposes is prohibited.

provisions.what: After one year from the ratification of this article the manufacture, sale, or transportation of intoxicating liquors within, the importation thereof into, or the exportation thereof from the United States and all territory subject to the jurisdiction thereof for beverage purposes is hereby prohibited
forbids: the manufacture, sale, or transportation of intoxicating liquors within the United States and all territory subject to the jurisdiction thereof for beverage purposes
the importation thereof into, or the exportation thereof from the United States and all territory subject to the jurisdiction thereof for beverage purposes
conditions: After one year from the ratification of this article

review.title: Power to enforce Prohibition
review.plain: Congress and the several States have concurrent power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation.
powers: shall have concurrent power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation

provisions.what: The Congress and the several States shall have concurrent power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation
provisions.holder: The Congress and the several States

review.title: Time limit for ratifying the Eighteenth Amendment
review.plain: This article is inoperative unless ratified by the legislatures of the several States within seven years from the date of its submission to the States by Congress.

provisions.what: This article shall be inoperative unless it shall have been ratified as an amendment to the Constitution by the legislatures of the several States, as provided in the Constitution, within seven years from the date of the submission hereof to the States by the Congress
conditions: unless it shall have been ratified as an amendment to the Constitution by the legislatures of the several States, as provided in the Constitution, within seven years from the date of the submission hereof to the States by the Congress

review.title: Right to vote regardless of sex
review.plain: The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex. Congress has power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation.
rights: The right of citizens of the United States to vote
powers: Congress shall have power to enforce this article by appropriate legislation
limits: shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex

review.title: When terms of office end and begin
review.plain: The terms of the President and Vice President end at noon on the 20th day of January, and those of Senators and Representatives at noon on the 3d day of January; the terms of their successors then begin.

provisions.what: The terms of the President and Vice President shall end at noon on the 20th day of January, and the terms of Senators and Representatives at noon on the 3d day of January, of the years in which such terms would have ended if this article had not been ratified; and the terms of their successors shall then begin

review.title: Annual meeting of Congress
review.plain: Congress shall assemble at least once in every year, beginning at noon on the 3d day of January, unless Congress by law appoints a different day.

provisions.what: The Congress shall assemble at least once in every year, and such meeting shall begin at noon on the 3d day of January
exceptions: unless they shall by law appoint a different day

review.title: Death or failure to qualify of the President elect
review.plain: If the President elect has died, the Vice President elect becomes President. If no President has been chosen or the President elect fails to qualify, the Vice President elect acts as President until one qualifies; Congress may by law provide for the case where neither qualifies.
powers: the Congress may by law provide for the case wherein neither a President elect nor a Vice President elect shall have qualified

provisions.what: If, at the time fixed for the beginning of the term of the President, the President elect shall have died, the Vice President elect shall become President
conditions: If, at the time fixed for the beginning of the term of the President, the President elect shall have died

provisions.what: If a President shall not have been chosen before the time fixed for the beginning of his term, or if the President elect shall have failed to qualify, then the Vice President elect shall act as President until a President shall have qualified
conditions: If a President shall not have been chosen before the time fixed for the beginning of his term, or if the President elect shall have failed to qualify

provisions.what: the Congress may by law provide for the case wherein neither a President elect nor a Vice President elect shall have qualified, declaring who shall then act as President, or the manner in which one who is to act shall be selected, and such person shall act accordingly until a President or Vice President shall have qualified
conditions: wherein neither a President elect nor a Vice President elect shall have qualified

review.title: Death of candidates when Congress chooses
review.plain: Congress may by law provide for the case of the death of any of the persons from whom the House of Representatives may choose a President, or the Senate may choose a Vice President, when the right of choice has devolved upon them.
powers: The Congress may by law provide

provisions.what: The Congress may by law provide for the case of the death of any of the persons from whom the House of Representatives may choose a President whenever the right of choice shall have devolved upon them
conditions: whenever the right of choice shall have devolved upon them

provisions.what: The Congress may by law provide for the case of the death of any of the persons from whom the Senate may choose a Vice President whenever the right of choice shall have devolved upon them
conditions: whenever the right of choice shall have devolved upon them

review.title: Effective date of Sections 1 and 2
review.plain: Sections 1 and 2 of this article take effect on the 15th day of October following its ratification.

provisions.what: Sections 1 and 2 shall take effect on the 15th day of October following the ratification of this article

review.title: Time limit for ratifying the Twentieth Amendment
review.plain: This article is inoperative unless ratified by the legislatures of three-fourths of the several States within seven years from the date of its submission.

provisions.what: This article shall be inoperative unless it shall have been ratified as an amendment to the Constitution by the legislatures of three-fourths of the several States within seven years from the date of its submission
conditions: unless it shall have been ratified as an amendment to the Constitution by the legislatures of three-fourths of the several States within seven years from the date of its submission

review.title: Repeal of Prohibition
review.plain: The eighteenth article of amendment to the Constitution of the United States is repealed.

provisions.what: The eighteenth article of amendment to the Constitution of the United States is hereby repealed

review.title: State liquor laws protected
review.plain: Transporting or importing intoxicating liquors into any State, Territory, or possession of the United States for delivery or use there, in violation of its laws, is prohibited.

provisions.what: The transportation or importation into any State, Territory, or possession of the United States for delivery or use therein of intoxicating liquors, in violation of the laws thereof, is hereby prohibited
forbids: the transportation or importation into any State, Territory, or possession of the United States for delivery or use therein of intoxicating liquors, in violation of the laws thereof
conditions: in violation of the laws thereof
